title: Create database migration system
description: Build a lightweight migration runner for better-sqlite3. Each migration is a numbered SQL file with up/down sections. Runner tracks current version in a schema_version table, executes pending migrations on app startup, and supports rollback.
acceptance_criteria: schema_version table created on first run
Migration files in src/main/db/migrations/ with numeric prefixes
Runner executes pending migrations in order on app startup
Failed migrations roll back within a transaction
